mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exam_answer (record_id, question_id, student_answer, correct_answer, score, earned_score, is_correct, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.studentAnswer}, #{item.correctAnswer}, #{item.score}, #{item.earnedScore}, #{item.correct}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_answer a JOIN question q ON a.question_id = q.id JOIN exam_record r ON a.record_id = r.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper_question pq ON pq.question_id = a.question_id AND pq.paper_id = r.paper_id WHERE a.record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY pq.sort_order ASC, a.id ASC
